status_legend.todo: Feature specified but implementation not started
status_legend.in_progress: Feature actively being worked on (max 1 feature across workspace)
status_legend.failing: Feature implemented or partially implemented but verification failing
status_legend.passing: Feature verified with automated test evidence and passing commands

features.title: Presentation administration
features.user_visible_behavior: Admin can create, edit, publish, duplicate, and delete presentations with title, description, theme colors, logos, slide metadata, ending slide ID, revision, and asset manifest. Duplicating creates a new presentation revision without carrying over sessions or audience data.
features.notes: Includes D1 SQLite persistence, slide_metadata view, deterministic SHA-256 revision hashing, PUT/PATCH CRUD, and R2/D1 stale asset invalidation.

features.title: Live sessions
features.user_visible_behavior: Admin/presenter starts a session, generating a unique audience join URL and QR code. Attendees join anonymously and receive a session-scoped pseudonymous participant token. Session states include scheduled, live, and completed. Reconnection restores session state.
features.notes: Includes scheduled -> live -> completed lifecycle, Durable Object SQLite persistence (session_state, participants, _do_kv), WebSocket reconnect state restoration, Admin/Presenter QR code & join URL rendering, and OpenAPI 3.1.0 endpoint documentation.

features.title: Reveal.js plugin
features.user_visible_behavior: Reusable RevealAudience plugin attaches to Reveal.js lifecycle, synchronizing slide transitions with the backend. Supports data-slide-id and data-title metadata, respects 2D navigation, and ensures local deck navigation functions offline even if backend fails.
features.notes: Includes ready and slidechanged lifecycle hooks, 2D coordinate extraction, unblocked offline keyboard navigation, authenticated presenter WebSocket slide.changed dispatch, slide position reconciliation, and server-side unauthorized navigation rejection.

features.title: Follow mode
features.user_visible_behavior: Default audience mode locks client view to the speaker's active slide in real time, displaying slide title, slide number, question submission button, reaction emojis, and gated download controls without rendering raw slide DOM.
features.notes: Includes default follow mode, WebSocket slide.changed real-time sync, positionIndicator formatting, strict omission of slide body/fragment DOM, reactive subscriber updates, contextual Ask Question/Emoji/Download controls, and auto-reconnect backoff.

features.title: Solo mode
features.user_visible_behavior: Audience can switch to Solo mode with Previous/Next controls to browse previously revealed slides in presentation order without affecting the speaker. Skipped slides remain inaccessible. Returning to Follow mode jumps to current speaker slide.
features.notes: Includes seamless Follow/Solo toggling, Previous/Next navigation over revealed slides in presentation order, locked skipped slides, persistent revealed access despite speaker backtracking, undisturbed solo slide positioning during speaker advance, anchored questions/reactions/downloads, soloGoToSlide, and authoritative server-side 403 Forbidden enforcement.

features.title: Slide-scoped questions
features.user_visible_behavior: Audience can submit questions anchored to the currently viewed slide in either Follow or Solo mode. Questions target whole slide (not fragments). Optional participant name, sanitized text, server-side rate limits, and persistence with status pending/answered/dismissed.
features.notes: Includes whole-slide scoping stripping fragment anchors, XSS sanitization and length validation via domain createAudienceQuestion, optional participant name, per-participant rate limits, Durable Object embedded SQLite persistence and hydration across restarts, presenter moderation via updateQuestionStatus (answered/dismissed), and real-time WebSocket event broadcasting (question.submitted, question.updated).

features.title: Question upvoting
features.user_visible_behavior: Audience members can upvote questions (one upvote per participant per question) and retract their upvote. Enforced via composite primary key in SQLite. Live upvote counts propagate instantly to all clients.
features.notes: Includes single-upvote enforcement with vote retraction, DO SQLite question_upvotes composite primary key (question_id, participant_id), real-time WebSocket question.upvoted broadcast, dynamic question sorting by vote count and creation timestamp across API and client controllers, and slide revelation access control.

features.title: Embedded Q&A slide
features.user_visible_behavior: Slide with data-component='audience-qa' renders a ranked list view of questions with votes and statuses. Clicking a question enters detail view showing the question text and pre-rendered slide image without navigating Reveal.js away from Q&A slide. Escape/Back returns to list view.
features.notes: Includes data-component='audience-qa' slide detection and mounting, ranked question list view by votes, submitter name and Anonymous fallback, slide title resolution, status badges (pending/answered/dismissed), scroll position preservation during live WebSocket updates (question.submitted, question.upvoted, question.updated), internal detail view keeping Reveal.js coordinates unchanged (deck.slide not called), slide PNG download URL with image error graceful fallback, presenter Mark as Answered PATCH API action, and keyboard Escape/Back button interception preventing slide navigation.

features.title: Emoji reactions
features.user_visible_behavior: Attendees can trigger emoji reactions (👍, 🤔, ❤️, 😴) against the active slide. Server rate-limits submissions and aggregates counts at 500ms intervals, streaming updates to presenter view without disturbing audience navigation.
features.notes: Includes supported reaction emojis (👍, 🤔, ❤️, 😴), participant token rate limiting (10 req/s), unrevealed slide 403 / SLIDE_NOT_REVEALED rejection, Durable Object 500ms batched aggregation (reaction.summary) preventing WebSocket frame flooding with p95 latency < 1s under 500 concurrent participants, and audience/presenter real-time reaction HUD synchronization.

features.title: Contextual polls
features.user_visible_behavior: Supports single-choice, multiple-choice, and binary polls anchored to slides. Presenter opens/closes polls and reveals live aggregated results on the projected deck. Responses persist in SQLite with one response per participant rule.
features.notes: Enforces strict participant voting constraints server-side.

features.title: Adaptive navigation
features.user_visible_behavior: Allows defining branch rules based on slide IDs, poll outcomes, or vote thresholds. Matching rules emit suggestions to presenter, who must explicitly confirm before the deck branches. Visiting destination reveals that slide while keeping skipped branches unrevealed.
features.notes: Presenter maintains authoritative control; automated suggestions require human confirmation.

features.title: Presenter view
features.user_visible_behavior: Presenter interface shows current slide viewport, 2D directional arrows matching Reveal.js navigation, live reaction counts, question count, and connected attendee count. Controls and administrative actions never leak to the public projector view.

evidence.target: pnpm run verify and ./init.sh after reducing PR #51 new-code duplication

features.notes: Presenter and projector session pages are now served by the Worker via /presenter/:sessionId and /projector/:sessionId, with authenticated presenter navigation, keyboard arrow handling, live metrics refresh, and strict projection isolation from private controls.

features.title: Browser-side PNG generation
features.user_visible_behavior: Admin can trigger 'Generate All Slide Images' which uses browser DOM capture (SlideRenderer) to export each slide in its final visual state. Preserves aspect ratio, uploads PNGs to R2 tied to presentation revision, reports progress and retryable per-slide errors.
features.notes: Zero headless Chromium dependency on server; pure browser-based DOM capture.

features.title: Single-slide downloads
features.user_visible_behavior: Audience can download slide PNG if and only if slide ID is in revealedSlideIds and the asset exists for the current revision. Available in both Follow and Solo modes. Direct access to unrevealed slide PNGs returns 403 Forbidden.
features.notes: R2 URLs are never exposed directly to audience clients.

features.title: Native Reveal.js PDF export
features.user_visible_behavior: Admin opens Reveal.js native print layout (?print-pdf) with pdfSeparateFragments: false, produces high-fidelity PDF, and uploads it via admin panel to R2. Flags stale PDFs when presentation content is edited.
features.notes: Contains all slides including skipped ones per MVP specification.

features.title: Full presentation download
features.user_visible_behavior: Full PDF download is permanently unlocked for the session upon the speaker's first authorized visit to the configured ending slide. Available across all modes; disabled if current revision PDF is not uploaded.
features.notes: Speaker visit is authoritative trigger; attendee navigation or admin upload alone does not unlock.

features.title: Presentation duplication
features.user_visible_behavior: Admin can duplicate a presentation into an independent copy with its own slides, branding, and asset manifest. Live sessions, votes, questions, and participant data are never copied.
features.notes: Generates new presentation ID, fresh SHA-256 revisionHash, deep-cloned branding & D1 slide metadata without sessions or audience data.

features.title: Security and abuse prevention
features.user_visible_behavior: Enforces presenter/admin authentication, issues session-scoped opaque participant tokens, validates schemas runtime, sanitizes display inputs, enforces per-participant rate limits, and validates WebSocket origins.
features.notes: Private R2 bucket with time-bounded authorized streaming.

features.title: Resilience
features.user_visible_behavior: Reveal.js operates offline when disconnected. WebSocket clients reconnect with exponential backoff and resynchronize state idempotently. Temporary disconnection of presenter or projector does not corrupt authoritative state in Durable Object SQLite.
features.notes: Idempotent event processing via message UUID deduplication.

features.title: Automated testing
features.user_visible_behavior: Complete multi-tier automated test suite covering domain invariants, Worker/Durable Object SQLite boundaries, E2E multi-client navigation, and 500-1,000 participant load tests.
features.notes: Continuous verification integrated with GitHub Actions CI.

features.title: Word clouds
features.user_visible_behavior: Word cloud slide displays live aggregated term frequencies from attendee submissions. Submissions are normalized (case-insensitive, trimmed, sanitized), rate-limited, and presenter can open, close, reset, and show results on projection.
features.notes: Case and punctuation normalization prevents word fragmentation.

features.title: Session completion and download unlock
features.user_visible_behavior: Visiting designated ending slide permanently unlocks PDF download without completing session. Completing session requires explicit presenter action. Returning to earlier slides does not lock PDF or revoke revealed slide access.
features.notes: Explicit presenter completion prevents premature session termination.

features.title: Presenter/projector synchronization
features.user_visible_behavior: Projected presentation and presenter control view share a single authoritative session state in the Durable Object. Navigation commands from either interface update both simultaneously. Attendee events never navigate the deck.
features.notes: Durable Object orders concurrent slide transitions deterministically.

features.title: Asset access control
features.user_visible_behavior: Gated asset access ensures slide PNG downloads require slide revelation and current asset existence, while full PDF downloads require ending-slide visit and uploaded PDF. Prevents unauthorized enumeration via private R2 bucket.
features.notes: Access policies enforced at the Worker API boundary before R2 read.
